Path: business objects, records and views | records-forms.list-view-capabilities | P2

## Triage: first grade (family closure card) — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` (the views memo fills default columns into a view with no explicit columns, and the relay then applies that view's `hiddenFields` / `fieldOrder`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: on the object route, a `columns: []` view subtracts from and re-sorts the default columns, where the spec says an empty `columns` declares no projection, so neither key applies. PR objectui#10667 (objectui#10638, merged) implements that reading on the interface page, so the two routes compose one way apart. It is read-only inference with no measured `reach:` ⇒ p3. The family's card, objectui#10638, is closed, so this card is its closure card for the object route.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T19:36Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: **first, measure**: a `columns: []` view with both keys, drawn on the object route. Then apply `hiddenFields` / `fieldOrder` only when the view declares a non-empty `columns`, the same gate PR objectui#10667 put on `InterfaceListPage`, and census the other hosts that compose a view for the same order. Note that the spec text is on objectstack `origin/main` (objectstack#19598), not yet in the released 17.4.0. PR objectui#10667 has merged, so nothing is serial.
